title: Q-FIND-replication-ledger: make https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/ findable (5 gaps)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** findable workflow, daily
**Done check:** python3 -m foundation findable --probe replication-ledger
**Status:** open

https://replication-ledger.ultrastable.org/ is missing what search engines and AI agents read: schema.org JSON-LD; feed link; robots.txt names no sitemap; no sitemap.xml with urls; no llms.txt. Fix the property's own pages (shared seed modules first, so every system gets it). Closed by the same daily reading.
